choice_prompt:56:1311312009.source_cn: 好了，现任梅林，既然你来了，我终于可以将这把剑交给那个喜欢和自己过不去的女骑士了。
choice_prompt:56:1311312009.male: Well, now that you're here, my current Merlin, I can finally hand over this sword to the knight who likes to make things difficult for me.
choice_prompt:56:1311312009.female: Well, now that you're here, my current Merlin, I can finally hand over this sword to the knight who likes to make things difficult for me.

say:57:1311312010:0.text: What? Did you really think you're the greatest mage in history?
say:57:1311312010:0.source_cn: 怎么，以为你是古往今来唯一伟大的魔法师吗？
say:57:1311312010:0.male: What? Did you really think you're the greatest mage in history?
say:57:1311312010:0.female: What? Did you really think you're the greatest mage in history?

say:58:1311312011:0.text: It is an honorable title, for sure, but a few shortsighted mortals decided to bestow it upon you.
say:58:1311312011:0.source_cn: 这是个光荣的称号，只是现在没眼光的凡人将它授予了你。
say:58:1311312011:0.male: It is an honorable title, for sure, but a few shortsighted mortals decided to bestow it upon you.
say:58:1311312011:0.female: It is an honorable title, for sure, but a few shortsighted mortals decided to bestow it upon you.

choice:48:1:2.text: Why were you waiting for me?
choice:48:1:2.male: Why were you waiting for me?
choice:48:1:2.female: Why were you waiting for me?

choice:9:2:3.source_cn: 你选中瓦丽卡作为持剑者？

choice:4:0:1.text: My first time meeting a god.
choice:4:0:1.male: My first time meeting a god.
choice:4:0:1.female: My first time meeting a god.

say:59:1311312005:3.text: Why are you so surprised? This isn't your first time meeting a god.
say:59:1311312005:3.source_cn: 这么震惊？你又不是没见过神明。
say:59:1311312005:3.male: Why are you so surprised? This isn't your first time meeting a god.
say:59:1311312005:3.female: Why are you so surprised? This isn't your first time meeting a god.

say:60:1311312006:3.text: Ha, you wish. Everyone must slog through a sea of misery before they meet me. I assure you that the peace of eternal death has not found you yet.
say:60:1311312006:3.source_cn: 啊，想得美。人活着才能受折磨，永享安宁的好事现在还轮不到你。
say:60:1311312006:3.male: Ha, you wish. Everyone must slog through a sea of misery before they meet me. I assure you that the peace of eternal death has not found you yet.
say:60:1311312006:3.female: Ha, you wish. Everyone must slog through a sea of misery before they meet me. I assure you that the peace of eternal death has not found you yet.

say:0:1311313001:0.text: This is the great hall... Are we back at the castle?
say:0:1311313001:0.source_cn: 这是谒见大厅……我们回到城堡里了？

say:1:1311314001:0.text: I encountered the God of Death once more and chose to become a Graveborn to continue the fight... But this time...
say:1:1311314001:0.source_cn: 我……我又见到了死神大人，选择成为亡灵，继续战斗……但...
say:1:1311314001:0.male: I encountered the God of Death once more and chose to become a Graveborn to continue the fight... But this time...
say:1:1311314001:0.female: I encountered the God of Death once more and chose to become a Graveborn to continue the fight... But this time...

choice_prompt:2:1311314001.text: I encountered the God of Death once more and chose to become a Graveborn to continue the fight... But this time...
choice_prompt:2:1311314001.source_cn: 我……我又见到了死神大人，选择成为亡灵，继续战斗……但这次，这次……
choice_prompt:2:1311314001.male: I encountered the God of Death once more and chose to become a Graveborn to continue the fight... But this time...
choice_prompt:2:1311314001.female: I encountered the God of Death once more and chose to become a Graveborn to continue the fight... But this time...

say:5:1311314004:0.text: I possess two sets of memories... Which one is true?
say:5:1311314004:0.source_cn: 我的记忆，两个不同的记忆……到底哪一个才是真实的？
say:5:1311314004:0.male: I possess two sets of memories... Which one is true?
say:5:1311314004:0.female: I possess two sets of memories... Which one is true?

choice_prompt:6:1311314004.text: I possess two sets of memories... Which one is true?
choice_prompt:6:1311314004.source_cn: 我的记忆，两个不同的记忆……到底哪一个才是真实的？
choice_prompt:6:1311314004.male: I possess two sets of memories... Which one is true?
choice_prompt:6:1311314004.female: I possess two sets of memories... Which one is true?

say:8:1311314007:0.text: I understand now. It turns out, at that time...
say:8:1311314007:0.male: I understand now. It turns out, at that time...
say:8:1311314007:0.female: I understand now. It turns out, at that time...

narration:9:1311314008:0.text: Valka remains silent for a moment, her gaze distant, before she begins to recount what happened...
narration:9:1311314008:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡沉默了几秒，开始向我们讲述那时候发生的事情……

say:12:1311315001:0.text: It's time to face the consequences of your choice, Valka.
say:12:1311315001:0.source_cn: 去面对你的选择吧，瓦丽卡。

say:13:1311315002:3.text: What do you mean? I was only following your instructions, Lord of Death!
say:13:1311315002:3.source_cn: 面对我自己的选择……谨遵您的教诲，死神大人！

say:14:1311315003:3.text: Relax. Do as you please. The sword is already yours.
say:14:1311315003:3.source_cn: 喔，放松点，随便你怎么做都好，反正这把剑已经是你的了。

say:15:1311315004:0.text: You won't see me for a while. I've kept my promise for two thousand years. Now I need some rest...
say:15:1311315004:0.source_cn: 你们暂时不会见到我了。这约定的两千年，要休息多久才能补...

narration:17:1311315005:0.text: Death departs, leaving Valka to face her fate. Defeating Cryonaia is her choice. She inhales deeply, gripping her sword, a source of infinite courage. The blade's tip points at the enemy, her resolve unshakable.
narration:17:1311315005:0.source_cn: 死神离开了。瓦丽卡很清楚，击败冰之恶魔——这就是她的选...

choice:6:0:1.text: Which do you hope is true?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 艾雅封印她和你击败她，你希望哪个是真的？
choice:6:0:1.male: Which do you hope is true?
choice:6:0:1.female: Which do you hope is true?

say:19:1311314006:1.text: Is that so? My choice makes it real...?
say:19:1311314006:1.source_cn: 是这样吗？我的选择……就是真实？
say:19:1311314006:1.male: Is that so? My choice makes it real...?
say:19:1311314006:1.female: Is that so? My choice makes it real...?

choice:6:1:2.text: It's the one you wish to choose.
choice:6:1:2.male: It's the one you wish to choose.
choice:6:1:2.female: It's the one you wish to choose.

say:20:1311314003:1.text: Indeed... The God of Death has seen fit to bestow this sword upon me.
say:20:1311314003:1.source_cn: 是的……死神大人赐予我了一把剑……
say:20:1311314003:1.male: Indeed... The God of Death has seen fit to bestow this sword upon me.
say:20:1311314003:1.female: Indeed... The God of Death has seen fit to bestow this sword upon me.

choice:2:1:2.text: You've obtained the Sword of Death.
choice:2:1:2.male: You've obtained the Sword of Death.
choice:2:1:2.female: You've obtained the Sword of Death.

say:1:1311317001:0.text: You're right, Merlin. I already know how the story ends.
say:1:1311317001:0.source_cn: 梅林，你说得对，我已经知道真正的历史应该是怎样的了。
say:1:1311317001:0.male: You're right, Merlin. I already know how the story ends.
say:1:1311317001:0.female: You're right, Merlin. I already know how the story ends.

say:2:1311317002:0.text: Yes, Valka! Chippy sees the determination in your eyes. You're not afraid of her anymore!
say:2:1311317002:0.source_cn: 太好了！瓦丽卡，你坚定了好多，你不怕她了，对不对？

say:3:1311317003:0.text: Yes, given that my choice determines everything, then this time...
say:3:1311317003:0.source_cn: 没错，既然我的选择就是真实的历史，那么这次——

say:0:1311318001:1.source_cn: 亚莲娜公主，她已经……已经……

say:1:1311318002:1.text: She is with Dura now. May she rest in peace.
say:1:1311318002:1.source_cn: 安息吧，愿她进入女神的国度……
say:1:1311318002:1.male: She is with Dura now. May she rest in peace.
say:1:1311318002:1.female: She is with Dura now. May she rest in peace.

say:1:1311319001:0.source_cn: 殿下？……殿下，公主殿下！！艾雅在上，不，这不是真的……

say:2:1311319002:0.text: I failed in my duty... When Her Highness asked me to go to the castle to get her gown, I should've refused... My duty was to stay by her side. This is my fault...
say:2:1311319002:0.source_cn: 是我失职……殿下让我来城堡为她拿舞会礼服的时候，我就应...

say:3:1311319003:1.text: Don't blame yourself, Sir Rodrigo. Even if you refused, the princess would've found another way to send you away. You don't know, but she was actually... well...
say:3:1311319003:1.source_cn: 罗德里戈先生，别这样自责。就算你拒绝了，她也会用别的方...

say:5:1311319005:0.text: Tell me what happened with Her Highness!
say:5:1311319005:0.source_cn: 告诉我发生了什么？公主殿下她……她……你们告诉我啊，到...

choice_prompt:6:1311319005.text: Tell me what happened with Her Highness!
choice_prompt:6:1311319005.source_cn: 告诉我发生了什么？公主殿下她……她……你们告诉我啊，到底怎么了！

say:7:1311319008:0.text: So, you're saying that the princess died a year ago? She didn't come back to life because of Dura's grace...
say:7:1311319008:0.source_cn: ……你们是说公主殿下一年前真的病逝了？她不是得到艾雅的...

say:8:1311319009:0.text: Dura's grace? Did the Archduke tell you that?
say:8:1311319009:0.source_cn: 艾雅的神恩？原来大公是这样告诉你的吗？

say:9:1311319010:0.text: At that time, we all thought that Her Highness had passed away. The whole castle was in mourning. But a few days later, the Archduke suddenly told us that because of our piety, Dura had bestowed her grace, and the princess was resurrected...
say:9:1311319010:0.source_cn: 那时候我们都以为殿下过世了，整个城堡里都弥漫着悲伤。可...

say:10:1311319011:0.text: We saw Her Highness walk out of the temple with our own eyes, the same as before... We never thought this was a trick of a Hypogean!
say:10:1311319011:0.source_cn: 我们亲眼看到殿下从小礼拜堂里走出来，和以往一模一样……...

say:11:1311319012:0.text: I know it's hard to accept, but it's the truth...
say:11:1311319012:0.source_cn: 虽然很难接受……但……确实是这样。

say:12:1311319013:0.text: You could've taken my life, Dura. Why did you take the princess? Did you want her boundless smile with you that badly...?
say:12:1311319013:0.source_cn: 艾雅啊，您可以取走我的性命，但您却带走了公主殿下……您...

say:14:1311319015:1.text: Let him be for the moment. He requires time to come to terms with all that has transpired.
say:14:1311319015:1.source_cn: 让他一个人平静一会儿吧，他需要一点时间来接受这一切。

say:15:1311319016:1.text: If Sir Rodrigo has come to the castle, that means the time loop has ended...
say:15:1311319016:1.source_cn: 既然罗德里戈来到了城堡，那时间循环应该已经被解除了……

say:16:1311319017:0.text: Yes, we should <style="highlight">go check on Cedartown</style>! Chippy hopes everyone there is okay... What about you, Valka?

say:17:1311319018:1.text: I wish to go check on my companions. I shall take my leave.
say:17:1311319018:1.source_cn: 我得去看看我那些……战友的情况。各位，我先告辞了。

say:19:1311319006:0.text: Yes, I need to get a hold of myself... I am a knight and the captain of the palace guard. I need to fulfill my duties...
say:19:1311319006:0.source_cn: 是的，我……我要冷静，我是、我是骑士，是宫廷侍卫长，该...

say:20:1311319007:0.text: Forgive my outburst, but you must tell me what happened.
say:20:1311319007:0.source_cn: ……请原谅我的冲动。但你们必须告诉我，到底发生了什么？

choice_prompt:21:1311319007.text: Forgive my outburst, but you must tell me what happened.
choice_prompt:21:1311319007.source_cn: ……请原谅我的冲动。但你们必须告诉我，到底发生了什么？

choice:6:1:2.text: I'll tell you, just take a breath first.
choice:6:1:2.male: I'll tell you, just take a breath first.
choice:6:1:2.female: I'll tell you, just take a breath first.

say:5:1311301201:0.text: What precisely is that creature? I've never encountered anything of its like before. It doesn't seem to be Hypogean in nature.
say:5:1311301201:0.source_cn: ……那怪物到底是什么？我没见过这样的东西，它不像是恶魔眷属。

say:6:1311301202:0.text: It seems a little like a Graveborn but very different from someone like Valka...
say:6:1311301202:0.source_cn: 感觉它有点像亡灵，可又和瓦丽卡你们很不一样……

choice_prompt:7:1311301202.text: It seems a little like a Graveborn but very different from someone like Valka...
choice_prompt:7:1311301202.source_cn: 感觉它有点像亡灵，可又和瓦丽卡你们很不一样……

say:8:1311301203:0.text: Indeed... I can sense the essence of death emanating from it.
say:8:1311301203:0.source_cn: 是的……我能感觉到它身上属于死神的力量。
say:8:1311301203:0.male: Indeed... I can sense the essence of death emanating from it.
say:8:1311301203:0.female: Indeed... I can sense the essence of death emanating from it.

say:9:1311301204:0.source_cn: 诶，死神？！难道说……我们已经死了？！

say:11:1311301206:0.text: Regardless, this is the only path before us.
say:11:1311301206:0.source_cn: 不管怎样，我们都只有这条路可走了。

choice:7:0:1.text: It's wrapped in the power of death.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 它身上缠绕着死亡的力量
choice:7:0:1.male: It's wrapped in the power of death.
choice:7:0:1.female: It's wrapped in the power of death.

choice:7:1:2.text: Maybe it's a creation of death.
choice:7:1:2.male: Maybe it's a creation of death.
choice:7:1:2.female: Maybe it's a creation of death.

narration:14:13011313:0.text: After defeating the enemies, the massive abyss gate shines brightly, as if beckoning you to enter.
narration:14:13011313:0.source_cn: 在击败突然出现的敌人之后，巨大的冥渊之门发出了明亮的光...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1311301102:.text: Who is that? No... what is that?!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1311301102:.source_cn: 那是谁？不……那是什么东西？！

subtitle:1:1311092011:.text: Death, or the curse of eternity?

subtitle:1:1311092013:.text: You plead, and I grant you a choice.

subtitle:1:1311092015:.text: or rise as a Graveborn and keep fighting
subtitle:1:1311092015:.source_cn: 或是成为亡灵，继续战斗

subtitle:1:1311092016:.text: but destined to be loathed and forgotten...
subtitle:1:1311092016:.source_cn: 但永远被人厌恶和遗忘……

subtitle:1:1311093001:.text: Aren't you going to take it?

subtitle:1:1311093002:.text: If not, I'll have to take it back.

subtitle:1:1311095001:.text: Even with the God of Death's power...

subtitle:1:1311095005:.text: my warriors and I have waited an eternity.
